headline: Photosynthesis converts sunlight into food—leaves are the foundation of almost all life on Earth
universal_truth: Everything depends on something; understanding foundational processes reveals what truly matters
fun_facts: Leaves produce all the oxygen in our atmosphere—every breath you take comes from photosynthesis
Photosynthesis converts about 100 billion tons of carbon into plant matter each year
A single tree can produce enough oxygen for two people for a year
discussion_questions: What's the 'photosynthesis' in your life—the foundational process everything depends on?
What upstream inputs make all your outputs possible?
Where does your 'energy' really come from?

hook.script: Every hamburger, every apple, every chicken wing—all of it traces back to a leaf catching sunlight. Photosynthesis is the original manufacturing: turning light into food, supporting virtually all life on Earth. Leaves feed the world.

cliff.script: Photosynthesis seems like just a plant thing—but it's the foundation of almost all life. What does this teach us about systems?

options.text: Everything depends on foundational processes—complex systems rest on simpler ones; understanding the base level reveals what truly matters and what's at risk
options.response: Yes. Remove photosynthesis and almost everything dies. The foundation matters most. Complex achievements rest on simpler essentials. Know your dependencies.

options.text: Plants just happen to need light
options.response: They need it, and so does everything that eats them—or eats things that eat them...

fact1.title: Universal Dependency
fact1.script: Herbivores eat plants. Carnivores eat herbivores. Decomposers break down both. Everything traces back to sunlight captured by leaves. One process, one foundation, endless variety.

fact2.title: Energy Flow
fact2.script: Photosynthesis is the entry point for energy into the living world. Without it, no food chains, no ecosystems, no you. Understanding energy flow reveals what actually matters.

fact3.title: Personal Foundations
fact3.script: What's your photosynthesis—the foundational process that everything else depends on? Health? Income? Key relationship? Core skill? Protect your foundations; everything else is downstream.

wisdom.script: Here's today's wisdom: Everything depends on something. Understanding foundational processes reveals what truly matters. Protect your foundations.

outro.script: That's Day 274—welcome to October! Tomorrow, we'll explore energy from falling water. Until then, identify what foundational process your life depends on.

growTrack.title: Foundation Mapping - What Does Everything Depend On?
growTrack.learning_objective: Identify foundational processes in your life
growTrack.activity: What's the 'photosynthesis' in your life—the thing everything else depends on? Health? Primary income source? Key relationship? If that fails, what else collapses? Protect and strengthen your foundations.
